directive:
Run the scrutiny panel. A previous run found issues (scrutiny_results.json is stale/missing). Submit scrutiny_outcome based on panel results.

Retry cap: the blocking retries in a run are shared by scrutiny, review and qa_validation and follow progress. The first 2 are granted whatever the counts. A third is granted only when this panel's count of blocking findings is lower than on its own previous blocking round in this run, and no run gets more than 3. `panel-retry-budget.sh` applies the rule and records each retry it grants in the context key `panel_retries`, so before running the retry loop, run `"skills/work-on/scripts/panel-retry-budget.sh" "issue_42" scrutiny <count>` once for the round, where the count is the sum of `blocking_count` over this round's reviewers, counted the same way every round. Exit 0 grants the retry: run the retry loop, which submits `blocking_retry`. Any other exit refuses it: submit `blocking_escalate` with the reason it printed as `failure_reason`, which ends the run at `done_blocked`.
